name: Art of Ism
storyline:
"Art of Ism" is the first entry of a planned series.
Having a completely fresh start thanks to being the new girl in town, our main protagonist, Ashley, intends to befriend her fellow lonely new classmates, forming an unlikely friend group.

See? What a wholesome story! Definitely nothing suspicious going on in the background, nuh-uh! Not at all. Do you think they believe me now? I mean, they say a lie repeated many times becomes the truth...

Fine, you got me! The new headmaster investigates the mysteries of the school, including the disappearance of the previous headmaster. It's something I am definitely not connected to at all, nuh-uh, so stop asking! More importantly, it's also something that the students will be dragged into after finding out their connection to the mystery of not just the school, but the town as a whole.

Um... Maybe let's change the subject before I spoil everything, shall we?
summary: A new girl in town, Ashley, tries to befriend her lonely classmates. But can an unlikely group of friends of such different personalities be formed and survive? Meanwhile, the new headmaster investigates the mysteries of the school.
